build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with parameterized static bars and a dynamic ball
create_static_bar: create a static bar obstacle with configurable angle, scale, and vertical position
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object positioned at the top of the scene
update_task_relationship: update the task goal to require the ball touching the lower bar
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to the PRE_TWO_BALLS solution difficulty tier
